name: image-toolkit
description: Compress, crop, resize, convert, watermark and inspect workspace images with browser Canvas processing and four AI tools.

name: webmail
description: Read and send mail from the browser over IMAP and SMTP, with new-mail notifications and an optional switch that lets the agent manage the mailbox itself.

name: db-client
description: Browse schemas, run SQL and edit rows across MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, SQL Server, MongoDB and Redis. Drivers install themselves on first activation.

name: vscode-editor
description: A VSCode-style workbench: multi-root file tree, tabbed CodeMirror editing, xterm.js terminals in a bottom panel, Remote-SSH browsing and SFTP sync.

name: mermaid
description: Renders mermaid fences in messages as SVG diagrams. A renderer plugin: the engine is only fetched when such a fence actually appears, so ordinary chat pays nothing.

name: run-trace
description: Collects a run into one replayable timeline of task, reasoning, tool calls, file changes and result, with detail for every node.

name: mcp-manager
description: Manage MCP servers from the web UI through pi-mcp-adapter: inspect the effective configuration with its provenance, enable or disable servers, and add or remove them.

name: UI Shortcuts
description: Switch between views with keyboard shortcuts, or bind composer drafts and new-chat prompts to custom keys.
